trigger_condition: fs.access fails for non-ENOENT reason (EACCES, EPERM) on marker path
guard_snippet: if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'ENOENT') logger.warn('Connect marker check failed', error);
potential_consequence: Connect install misdetected as standalone; CLI self-updates and overwrites the managed install

trigger_condition: CLI is bundled or relocated so dirname is not two levels below package root
guard_snippet: const root = await findPackageRoot(dirname); await fs.access(path.join(root, 'codemie-connect.json'));
potential_consequence: Marker never found; Connect installs silently self-update despite the marker
